limitations: One training seed; no algorithm/default promotion or equilibrium certificate.
Positive average mass is not a convergence or low-variance certificate.
Baseline street coverage does not isolate rare 3bet/postflop branches.
Node conditional rates use each checkpoint own preceding ranges, self-normalized reach ratios, and delta-method standard errors.
Reference percentages are rounded and full tree, abstraction, and rake equivalence is not established.
All three individually audited nodes are preflop heads-up continuations, not multi-player postflop strategy validation.
End-to-end process timing includes initialization, evaluation, serialization and disposal.

Audit deviator training used 256 traversals per seat and retained zero infosets in all seats at both checkpoints; trained-candidate replay falls back entirely to the main regret-greedy candidate, not an independent strong best response.
